evidence.paraphrase: 3D scene representation (Blender) shared across shots. Each shot is rendered from the shared 3D world; continuity is inherent.

Agents modify the persistent 3D world state across shots (fixed editing rules). For Kubrick, this specifically supports LLM-mediated memory editing of Persistent 3D world state (geometry, assets, camera).

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are deliberately linked or jointly consumed by downstream reasoning, generation, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 12): During inference, the operative memory component (Persistent 3D world state (geometry, assets, camera)) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
